Great wine bar in Da Nang
Jan 2025 • Couples
If you're feeling a little homesick from Western life, or just do something different, this is a great relaxed spot for chilling. 
Excellent service, comfortable, and a great selection of wines. Happy Hour from 4p.m. to 7p.m. where their offering is 2 for the price on 1, but it has to be the same drink. 
A lovely upstairs indoor balcony, great for a small group or, as we had, just the 2 of us.
They also offer grazing platters of cold cuts and cheese if you aren't able to move on.
Really a lovely place.
